```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")
library(RdistNN)
set.seed(3)
```

## Overview

`RdistNN` is designed to be extensible:

- Define custom distances with `as_distance()` / `new_distance()`
- Register distances via `register_distance()`
- Define custom rank-weight rules with `as_rank_weight()` / `new_rank_weight()`
- Register rank rules via `register_rank()`
- Define custom U-stat score kernels with `as_score()` / `new_score()`

## 1) Custom Distance

```{r distance, eval=FALSE}
# L-infinity distance
linf <- as_distance(
  function(X, x0, ctx = NULL) {
    apply(abs(X - matrix(x0, nrow(X), ncol(X), byrow = TRUE)), 1L, max)
  },
  name = "linf"
)

register_distance("linf", linf)
distance_names()
```

## 2) Custom Rank-Weight Rule

```{r rank-weight, eval=FALSE}
# inverse-rank weights w_r proportional to 1 / r
rw_inv <- as_rank_weight(
  function(ranks, ctx = NULL) {
    w <- 1 / as.numeric(ranks)
    w / sum(w)
  },
  name = "inv_rank"
)

register_rank("inv_rank", rw_inv)
rank_names()
```

## 3) Use Custom Components in `weights_matrix()`

```{r matrix, eval=FALSE}
n <- 80
p <- 2
X <- matrix(rnorm(n * p), n, p)
X0 <- matrix(rnorm(4 * p), 4, p)

out <- weights_matrix(
  X = X, X0 = X0,
  ranking = "linf",
  weight = get_rank("inv_rank"),
  return = c("W", "ranks")
)

dim(out$W)
```

## 4) Custom Score Kernel

```{r score, eval=FALSE}
# Order-2 score: average of two selected observations
sc_avg2 <- as_score(
  function(idxs, data, ctx = NULL, rng = NULL) {
    mean(data[idxs])
  },
  s = 2L,
  name = "avg2"
)

register_score(sc_avg2)
list_scores()

data_vec <- rnorm(10)
subs <- rbind(c(1L, 2L), c(4L, 8L), c(3L, 9L))
score_eval_batch(sc_avg2, subs = subs, data = data_vec)
```

## 5) Practical Advice

- Keep custom evaluators deterministic unless randomness is required.
- Return finite numeric outputs with the expected dimensions.
- Use `return = c("ranks", "ord", "dx")` when debugging custom ranking behavior.
- Add unit tests for each custom rule before integrating into production workflows.
